answer: Dishonest graders are slashed and their stake is redistributed, which means a Sybil cluster that tries to vote as a bloc will, on average, lose more from slashing than it gains from manipulating a single verdict. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a vine as the anchor of the cost.
